acceptance_test_interpretation: M0V4-EXACT-SOURCE-RATIFIABILITY-00 is the prospective closure gate: before preparation execution or implementation, every outcome-relevant semantic table, schema, source byte, mutation, checker, runtime identity, roster, endpoint, and prohibition must be individually hash-bound; the present decision concerns whether those inert bytes may be authored, not whether absent candidate fixture bytes may be treated as frozen. M0V4-ZERO-V7-RUNTIME-REUSE-01 makes V7 governance evidence only and must reject indirect reuse through copied constants, goldens, hashes, subprocesses, fixtures, or receipts as well as imports. M0V4-DISJOINT-CHECKER-AND-MUTATION-02 appropriately combines independent constructive reconstruction with axiomatic checking and field-complete mutations; agreement supports reproducibility plus checked invariants, not proof that the human specification is scientifically correct. M0V4-ACTOR-NONORACLE-03 is necessary because a current-state legality list would reveal the next action: V4 instead requires a fixed catalog, charged NO_EFFECT for wrong catalogued relations, ordinary WRONG_FINISH, neutral handles, V3 rejection, and public capabilities as the sole dependency authority. M0V4-BUNDLED-READER-READ-CUT-04 identifies the intended connection intervention only if exhaustive closure proves AUTH can expose one complete registered route within eight reads while ATOMS cannot obtain p1, p3, p4, or any link before the first relation attempt closes reading; this is a property of the instrument, not model evidence. M0V4-VISIBILITY-RESET-NONINTERFERENCE-05 is the primary shortcut firewall: paired worlds must have identical actor-visible bytes until an ordinary separating outcome, later divergence must descend from that outcome, abandoned branch material must not join, and reset must preserve only the condition's declared carrier. Its final model-facing form must compare rendered system/user/template/token bytes, tool returns, and session state, not semantic objects alone. M0V4-PROVENANCE-TRANSFORM-DAG-06 must establish a total proposal-before-support order, independent later grounding, alias-normalized root deduplication, legal diamonds, cycle rejection, contradiction and irreversible revocation, transform non-admission, identity-null EMPTY, and pointer-local transforms. M0V4-CAS-TWO-FREEZE-DURABILITY-07 correctly separates approval of exact preparation source from human admission of generated candidate bytes; per-file CAS, acyclic identities, one terminal run receipt, no overwrite, and fail-closed recovery prevent a successful checker or retry from promoting a fixture. M0V4-CPU-CONFORMANCE-08 is post-implementation and pre-model evidence only: it can validate the finite reducer, transitions, transforms, handoff, and receipts against one second-human-frozen fixture, but cannot establish usefulness or learning. MTEXTV4-RENDERED-BOUNDARY-09 must bind every model-visible byte, tokenizer result, parser/controller behavior, cache/session rule, model/runtime file, output limit, and reset destruction rule before DEV; semantic M0 equality alone is insufficient. MTEXTV4-ROSTER-ENDPOINT-RESOURCE-10 fixes the 18-condition, 501-slot-per-root and 148224-allowed-generated-token-per-root maxima, the balanced 16/32/16-root split, phase applicability with NA, NOT_REACHED suffix sealing, exact integer gates, root-wise strongest-text baseline formula, negative dispositions, and physical-device ceilings. It must reject any hidden call or any NA consumed by a required gate. MTEXTV4-CONFIRMATION-CLAIM-GATE-11 permits evidence only from a complete sealed confirmation census under one frozen model and topology. DEV, incomplete cells, reserve rescue, pooled internal repetitions, or a favorable subset cannot support the claim. Passing can support only conditional supplied-memory use: task benefit and connected-content dependence from path conditions, informative choice and revision from separately public calibration evidence, and delayed use of a supplied persistent carrier. It cannot credit DREAM, SLEEP, LoRA, acquisition-to-retention, online learning, or the full organism.

assumptions: No V4 systems interpretation or other V4 interpreter output was received or read.
The listed V2 interpretations are historical, hash-bound predecessor evidence explicitly included in the required V4 context, not another interpretation of this V4 change.
The present proposal authorizes no source edit, preparation execution, fixture generation, implementation, model call, GPU use, or scientific claim.
The future exact preparation-source bundle will resolve every schema, table, transform, mutation, runtime, roster, endpoint, and receipt choice without implementation-time discretion.

All 64 M0 roots form an exhaustive engineering universe. M-TEXT confirmation is a deterministic finite census of one fixed model and topology; roots, twins, goals, phases, conditions, calls, and aliases do not create a population sample.
AUTH carriers, indexes, public handles, and presentation order are constructed before later goals and without access to scores, expected answers, model behavior, or condition labels.

Offline truth is confined to checker/reporting functions and explicitly registered deterministic fixture construction; it cannot select retrievals, prompts, commands, model-visible aliases, or favorable roots.

The supplied DELAYED_ENTRY is a factorial fixture rather than the same policy's retained acquisition. Consequently delayed success is not retention, acquisition-to-use, online learning, or continued-life evidence.
The uncertainty table is directly public. Its experiment-choice assay measures use of calibrated prospective evidence and outcome-conditioned revision, not connected-memory use.
The frozen M-TEXT system prompt is a coached-use ceiling. Success shows that the fixed policy can execute the supplied-memory interface, not that it discovered the algorithm.

Raw context, RAG, and native graph are honest alternative-memory routes with separately reported resource costs. Failure to beat raw context and RAG removes practical-superiority language but does not automatically negate a separately passing matched-intervention causal result.

Bridge removal, DERANGED connectivity, reachout removal, scratch removal, and no-feedback tape are distinct interventions. The last two do not ablate DREAM recurrence, and none substitutes for scale or lifetime-length ablations.

LoRA and text cannot be called fixed-memory matched substrates merely because their semantic payload is the same; capacity, stored bytes, retrieval work, context, training work, compute, and opportunity must be prospectively charged in a future transport package.
claim_delta_interpretation: The claim decomposition is appropriately narrow. M0 evidence can establish only that a clean-room finite CPU instrument, its visibility and provenance rules, its interventions, its reducer, and its public handoff conform to exact frozen bytes. M-TEXT confirmation can establish conditional behavioral usefulness only for one frozen model and topology. Substrate-neutral AUTH advantages over ATOMS, DERANGED, BRIDGE_CUT, and REACHOUT_OFF can support action/task improvement attributable to accessible authentic connections when paired with the non-oracle catalog, read cut, shortcut controls, and zero-net-harm gate. Goal-specific constructive traces plus bridge and binding counterfactuals can support bounded composition and connected-content dependence; citations alone cannot. Separating experiment choice, realized information, belief revision, and commit must remain separate evidence, because public calibration rather than graph connectivity supplies that mechanism. Delayed AUTH versus OLD_CUT, NEW_CUT, and NO_PERSIST_NEW can support dependence on a supplied old-plus-new carrier after reset, but the model-independent delayed entry prevents any acquisition-to-retention or online-learning interpretation. Memory transport is wholly untested because no text-versus-LoRA intervention exists. Online learning would require memory to alter an action, the action to alter public evidence, a grounded persistent write to alter later memory, and that memory to improve a later action in one causal lineage; V4 deliberately breaks this chain into factorial assays. Continued improvement requires separately raised lineages, increasing genuinely new information, lifetime-length variation, retention, a certified evolving text baseline with prospective plateau, positive late slope, slope advantage, and terminal margin. No V4 result supports those claims, nor DREAM authorship, SLEEP consolidation, accumulation across dreams/lives, compression, parenting, topology generalization, or whole-organism behavior. Any instrument breach, missing confirmation receipt, failed noncompensatory gate, or resource halt withdraws the corresponding claim, and reserve cannot repair confirmation.
graph_delta_interpretation: The graph creates a disciplined authority and evidence chain rather than the full learning organism. A clean-room source contract may lead, after separate approval, to one deterministic candidate fixture checked by disjoint checkers. A second human freeze is the sole admission edge to later M0 implementation. M0 then exposes a finite public world, a capability-bounded reader, supplied carriers, and model-free handoffs while private semantic identities, oracles, and receipts terminate at checker/controller boundaries. A separately approved M-TEXT node may consume only the verified public handoff and its own exact rendered/session contract; model output has no upstream edge to fixtures or preparation. This graph can force a bounded supplied-memory relay to be behaviorally useful through task, bridge, derangement, binding, read-access, shortcut, and delayed-cut contrasts. It does not force the complete Dream–LoRA–Think organism to be useful because there is no executed edge that lets the policy's own experiences create target-independent local DREAM proposals, accumulate supported edges over multiple dreams or lives, write them persistently, transport them into LoRA, or improve across increasing lifetimes. Those operations terminate at N-DEFERRED-DREAM-LORA-ORGANISM with no trigger. Raw context, RAG, and native graph are legitimate alternative paths inside the M-TEXT assay; their success is not a shortcut breach, but it limits practical-superiority claims. Target-only, no-memory, and passive-signature success above their registered ceilings is a benchmark-specificity failure. A future text-versus-LoRA transport graph must hold semantic load and memory opportunity prospectively fixed while charging bytes, capacity, retrieval, context, training, inference, and compute separately.

loop_delta_interpretation: The intended complete organism has a strict temporal and causal order: an action produces an ordinary public outcome; only eligible grounded episodes later enter target-independent DREAM processing; DREAM proposes local connections or re-expressions without seeing the future goal; still later independent evidence supports, contradicts, or revokes those proposals; SLEEP transactionally transports only validated personal semantics; a later goal causes THINK to retrieve local memory and compose a goal-conditioned route only when needed; THINK acts, observes, and revises; and those later outcomes may become eligible input to subsequent dream cycles. Local edges should therefore accumulate across episodes, dreams, and lives while complete goal paths remain demand-constructed rather than prewritten. V4 instantiates only a finite lived-world instrument and a supplied-text use loop. Its reference compiler is not DREAM, its carrier is not self-written memory, and its temporary model scratch is not SLEEP or persistent personal state. The M-TEXT path phases provide a legitimate bounded test of demand-time composition: memory is read before action, the first relation attempt closes reading, and task execution follows under a later released goal. The U phase separately tests whether public calibration and an observed outcome change choice, belief, and commit. The D phase begins from a model-independent supplied old-plus-new entry, so it tests carrier use after sterile reset but deliberately severs U from D. Scratch-off tests explicit within-phase state carriage; no-feedback tape tests closed-loop interaction; neither removes recurrent DREAM growth. DERANGED tests wrong connectivity, bridge cut tests a necessary connection set, and reachout-off tests connection accessibility. Scale, dream-cycle count, accumulated-edge count, path length, distractors, number of goals, and lifetime length are not varied. Thus V4 can establish bounded representation use and composition but cannot establish memory writing, transport, multi-life accumulation, online learning, or continued improvement.
system_thesis_interpretation: Dream–LoRA–Think is a recurrent organism whose usefulness must ultimately arise from a causal chain, not from naming its organs. The organism acts and receives grounded public outcomes; DREAM later grows target-independent local candidate edges and re-expressions; independent subsequent evidence validates or revokes them; SLEEP transactionally transports validated personal semantics into persistent parametric state; THINK receives a later goal, retrieves and composes only the needed route, acts, observes, and revises; and new outcomes can seed later dream cycles. Scientific evidence must separately identify memory transport, goal-conditioned composition, action improvement, grounded online learning, accumulation, and continued lifetime improvement. V4 measures only a deliberately supplied relay. Its two-goal tasks, bridge/derangement/binding controls, pre-action bundled reader, and connected trace diagnostics can test whether connected supplied memory contributes to demand-time composition and useful action. Its calibrated public uncertainty can separately test informative action choice and revision. Its delayed cuts can test whether a supplied persistent carrier is needed after reset. It cannot test whether the agent authored the edges, whether a write carried its own acquisition forward, whether LoRA transported memory, whether local edges accumulated over dreams or lives, or whether performance continued improving. The fixed topology also prevents a general memory-intelligence or topology-generalization claim. A future organism test must preserve the action→outcome→dream→support→write→later-goal separation, vary scale and lifetime, compare equal-opportunity text and LoRA substrates, and use independently raised lineages against a certified evolving text-memory baseline.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The proposed visibility boundary is scientifically suitable as a source direction if implemented exhaustively. Source and authority data are review inputs; actors receive no manifests, freeze IDs, roots, splits, conditions, semantic hashes, support roots, scores, or oracles. Private world truth may drive the finite controller and checker but cannot affect actor-visible bytes before a registered ordinary separating outcome. Public lived evidence crosses only closed projections. Supplied carriers use neutral stable capabilities whose mapping is fixed before goals and conditions; a capability becomes readable or citeable only through declared catalog/grant rules. The common reader may depend only on carrier, public anchor, cursor, reader-open state, and public repeat state. Fixed action catalogs prevent legal-action leakage, while charged NO_EFFECT and WRONG_FINISH keep ordinary policy errors from becoming hidden instrument failures. Forks and joins must exclude scratch, failed routes, retrieval histories, timing, scores, and sibling handles. The delayed carrier conditions must destroy every raw message, tool transcript, scratch item, workspace, capability, cache, KV state, request/session handle, filename, timing value, and condition label; only the declared carrier survives. Raw context, RAG, and native graph have separately declared alternative-memory channels and therefore cannot support the carrier-sole-channel conclusion. At M-TEXT, equality must cover system bytes, user bytes, chat-template output, token IDs, tool envelopes, parser-visible responses, decoding settings, cache/session state, and reset behavior. Query order, padding, aliases, request length, errors, NOT_REACHED slots, and routing identifiers must be independent of hidden bit, answer, score, condition, and split. Offline truth remains checker/reporting-only except where the frozen factorial fixture explicitly constructs a supplied public fact; it may never choose a query agenda, render an answer, or alter a policy opportunity.
